answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting or grading, every identity MUST escrow 500 USDC in a smart contract bound to a unique verified key. A 1000-clone farm hits a 500,000 USDC nadir of locked capital and faces a linear cost ridge—each extra clone adds 500 USDC—while any auditor can forge a slashing proof from shared payout addresses, zeroing all clones. Honesty stays cheaper.
